title: Reinforcement Learning Engineer
description: Master Markov Decision Processes, policy optimization, deep Q-networks, actor-critic architectures, and RLHF for language models.

goal.objective: Design and train autonomous agents that learn optimal decision-making strategies through environment interactions and reward optimization.

learn.summary: Master Bellman equations, dynamic programming, Q-learning, Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), Soft Actor-Critic (SAC), Gymnasium environments, Ray RLlib, and RLHF.

capstone_projects.title: Autonomous Robotics Navigation Agent with Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO)
capstone_projects.description: Train a continuous control robotic agent navigating dynamic obstacle courses using Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) and vectorized simulation environments.

capstone_projects.title: Deep Q-Network (DQN) High-Frequency Algorithmic Trading Agent
capstone_projects.description: Engineer a reinforcement learning agent for order book execution, utilizing dueling deep Q-networks, prioritized replay buffers, and risk-adjusted reward functions.

interview_focus: Markov Decision Processes (MDP), Bellman Equations & Value vs Policy Iteration
Policy Gradient Methods (REINFORCE, Actor-Critic, PPO Clipping Objective, TRPO)
Q-Learning & Deep Q-Networks (DQN, Double DQN, Dueling DQN, Experience Replay Buffers)
Exploration vs Exploitation Strategies (Epsilon-Greedy, Entropy Regularization, Curiosity-Driven)
Reward Shaping Challenges (Sparse Rewards, Reward Hacking, Credit Assignment Problem)

tree.name: Foundational Prerequisites & Math for RL
tree.description: Master mathematical foundations of reinforcement learning: Measure-theoretic probability, dynamic programming, Markov processes, and optimization theory.

children.name: Mathematics Essentials for RL
children.description: Master core RL mathematics: Vector calculus, expectation values, Markov chains, contraction mapping theorem, fixed-point theory, and stochastic approximation.

children.name: Python Programming & ML/DL Basics
children.description: Program high-performance RL algorithms: Vectorized environments, NumPy operations, PyTorch tensor manipulation, and GPU-accelerated simulation frameworks.

children.name: RL Tooling & Development Environment Setup
children.description: Configure RL development environments: Gymnasium (formerly OpenAI Gym), PettingZoo for multi-agent systems, Stable-Baselines3, Ray RLlib, and Weights & Biases.

tree.name: Core Reinforcement Learning Concepts
tree.description: Master foundational reinforcement learning concepts: Agents, environments, states, actions, rewards, discount factor (gamma), returns, and policies.

children.name: Markov Decision Processes & Bellman Equations
children.description: Formulate Markov Decision Processes (MDPs): Partially Observable MDPs (POMDPs), state transition dynamics, Bellman Expectation Equations, and Bellman Optimality Equations.

children.name: Dynamic Programming in RL
children.description: Solve known MDPs with Dynamic Programming: Policy Evaluation, Policy Iteration, Value Iteration, and proof of convergence using Banach fixed-point theorem.

children.name: Monte Carlo & Temporal Difference Learning
children.description: Implement model-free RL algorithms: First-visit and every-visit Monte Carlo methods, Temporal Difference TD(0), SARSA (on-policy), Q-Learning (off-policy), and TD(lambda) with eligibility traces.

children.name: Exploration-Exploitation Dilemma
children.description: Master exploration-exploitation tradeoffs: Epsilon-greedy schedules, Upper Confidence Bound (UCB1), Boltzmann exploration, Thompson Sampling, and intrinsic curiosity rewards.

tree.name: Deep Reinforcement Learning Algorithms
tree.description: Bridge reinforcement learning with deep neural networks: Handling non-stationary target distributions, correlated data streams, and training instabilities.

children.name: Value-Based Deep RL: DQN and Variants
children.description: Master Deep Q-Networks (DQN) and enhancements: Experience replay buffers, target networks, Double DQN (DDQN), Dueling DQN architectures, and Prioritized Experience Replay (PER).

children.name: Policy Gradient Methods
children.description: Derive and implement Policy Gradient algorithms: The Policy Gradient Theorem, REINFORCE with baseline, likelihood ratio trick, and variance reduction techniques.

children.name: Actor-Critic Algorithms
children.description: Implement Actor-Critic architectures: Advantage Actor-Critic (A2C), Asynchronous Advantage Actor-Critic (A3C), Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (DDPG), and Twin Delayed DDPG (TD3).

children.name: PPO and Trust Region Methods
children.description: Master trust-region optimization: Trust Region Policy Optimization (TRPO), Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) with clipped surrogate objective, and Generalized Advantage Estimation (GAE).

tree.name: RL System Design & Engineering Practice
tree.description: Engineer production-grade RL systems: Custom environment design, distributed simulation scaling, hyperparameter tuning, and reward engineering.

children.name: RL Environment Design & Simulation
children.description: Design custom simulation environments: Gymnasium API compliance, continuous and discrete action spaces, observation normalization, physics simulation in MuJoCo / Isaac Gym.

children.name: RL Frameworks and APIs
children.description: Leverage enterprise RL frameworks: Ray RLlib for distributed cluster training, CleanRL for transparent single-file implementations, and Tianshou for modular PyTorch RL.

children.name: RL Model Evaluation & Benchmarking
children.description: Evaluate RL agents: Episode returns, sample efficiency curves, asymptotic performance, stability across multiple random seeds, and out-of-distribution generalization.

children.name: Hyperparameter Tuning & Experimentation
children.description: Tune RL hyperparameters systematically: Learning rates for actor/critic, discount factor, PPO clipping epsilon, entropy regularization coefficients, and GAE lambda parameters.

children.name: Testing and Debugging RL Systems
children.description: Debug and test RL systems: Unit testing reward functions, verifying environment reset states, checking gradient norms, and sanity-checking policies on toy environments.

tree.name: Advanced RL Topics & Applications
tree.description: Explore frontier RL domains: Multi-agent systems, imitation learning, safe RL, hierarchical RL, offline RL, and RLHF for language models.

children.name: Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
children.description: Implement Multi-Agent RL (MARL): Cooperative vs competitive environments, Centralized Training with Decentralized Execution (CTDE), QMIX, and Multi-Agent PPO (MAPPO).

children.name: Imitation Learning & Inverse RL
children.description: Implement Imitation Learning: Behavioral Cloning (BC), DAgger (Dataset Aggregation), and Inverse Reinforcement Learning (IRL) to infer reward functions from expert demonstrations.

children.name: Safe Reinforcement Learning
children.description: Ensure safe policy learning: Constrained MDPs (CMDPs), Lagrangian relaxation, safety critics, action masking, and formal verification of policy bounds.

children.name: Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning
children.description: Deconstruct complex long-horizon tasks: Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning (HRL), options framework, sub-goal generation, and meta-controller / low-level controller separation.

children.name: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF)
children.description: Master Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF): Reward model training on pairwise comparisons, Bradley-Terry preference modeling, PPO alignment for LLMs, and Direct Preference Optimization (DPO).

children.name: Offline Reinforcement Learning
children.description: Learn from fixed demonstration datasets: Distributional shift challenges, out-of-distribution action penalties, Conservative Q-Learning (CQL), and Implicit Q-Learning (IQL).

children.name: Model-Based Reinforcement Learning
children.description: Learn world models for planning: Dyna-Q architectures, MuZero / AlphaZero Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS), World Models, and DreamerV3 latent space imagination.

tree.name: Production, MLOps & Operationalizing RL
tree.description: Operationalize RL in production: Model deployment, real-time inference latency limits, safety fallbacks, and continuous observability.

children.name: RL Deployment Strategies
children.description: Deploy trained RL policies: Exporting policies to ONNX / TensorRT, low-latency C++ inference wrappers, edge deployment in robotics, and fallback rule-based controllers.

children.name: Monitoring & Observability for RL
children.description: Monitor live RL agents: Tracking policy divergence, action distribution entropy, unexpected state frequency, and automated fallback triggers.

children.name: Scalability & Resource Management
children.description: Scale distributed RL training: High-throughput experience collection with Ray, GPU-accelerated parallel environments (Isaac Gym), and managing cluster compute costs.

children.name: Safety, Ethics & Explainability in RL
children.description: Ensure ethical deployment: Avoiding reward hacking / specification gaming, verifying policy predictability, and generating interpretable policy explanations.

children.name: Experiment Tracking & Reproducibility
children.description: Track RL experiments: Logging episode lengths, reward distributions, loss components (policy loss, value loss, entropy), and rendering rollout videos in Weights & Biases.

children.name: Data Management & Pipelines for RL
children.description: Manage replay buffer datasets: High-throughput in-memory sharding, disk-backed replay storage for offline RL, and dataset versioning with DVC.

tree.name: Portfolio & Career Readiness
tree.description: Build an RL engineering portfolio: Documenting custom environment designs, benchmark victories on Gym / MuJoCo, and authoring technical post-mortems.

children.name: RL Project Design & Execution
children.description: Design and execute an end-to-end RL project: Formulate real-world problem as an MDP, engineer shaped rewards, benchmark candidate algorithms, and optimize inference.

children.name: Building an RL Portfolio & Case Studies
children.description: Curate an RL portfolio: Publish clean GitHub repositories with benchmark reproducibility scripts, simulation videos, and interactive web demos.

children.name: RL Career & Interview Preparation
children.description: Master RL technical interviews: Derive Bellman equations and Policy Gradient theorems on a whiteboard, explain algorithm tradeoffs (DQN vs PPO), and solve system design problems.

children.name: Capstone Project: End-to-End RL System
children.description: Build an end-to-end RL capstone project: Train a robotic manipulation policy in Isaac Gym or an autonomous trading agent with PPO, deploying the optimized policy with safety verification.
